en: The Banaue Rice Terraces in Ifugao act as a giant inclined plane, reducing the physical effort needed for farmers to climb steep mountains.
Archimedes invented the Archimedes screw, a simple machine that uses a helical surface inside a pipe to lift water from lower to higher elevations.
The microscopic hairs on a Philippine tarsier's feet increase friction, allowing the small primate to grip tightly onto narrow tree branches without slipping.
The smooth, streamlined body of the sailfish reduces water friction, allowing this specific fish species to swim at incredible speeds up to 68 miles per hour.
Galileo Galilei famously demonstrated gravity by dropping two different masses from the Leaning Tower of Pisa to show they fall at the same rate.
The planet Jupiter has so much mass that its gravitational pull is strong enough to keep 95 known moons orbiting continuously around it.
The coastal town of Masinloc in Zambales contains large deposits of magnetite, a naturally magnetic iron ore that can attract small iron filings.
The Agus VI Hydroelectric Plant in Iligan City converts the kinetic energy of falling water from the Maria Cristina Falls into usable electrical energy.
The Hubble Space Telescope uses large mirrors to collect faint visible light from distant galaxies, allowing astronomers to see deep into the universe.
Alexander Graham Bell successfully transmitted clear human speech through his invention, the telephone, by converting sound waves into fluctuating electrical signals.
The Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant in Albay harnesses the Earth's internal heat by using underground steam to spin turbines and generate electricity.
The Calatagan Solar Farm in Batangas uses thousands of photovoltaic panels to convert radiant energy from the sun into usable electrical power.
